mechanism: Both drugs affect CNS function through different pathways; modafinil may increase pregabalin levels via CYP3A4 inhibition and compete for renal clearance, while additive CNS depression risk exists.
action: Monitor for increased pregabalin adverse effects (dizziness, somnolence, cognitive impairment); consider dose adjustment of pregabalin if CNS symptoms emerge; counsel patient on additive effects.
